title.zh: L/J 极点流体色散矩阵

summary: Assemble the dense first-order fluid eigenmatrix for fixed angular frequency and parallel wavenumber.

capability: Assemble the dense first-order fluid eigenmatrix for fixed angular frequency and parallel wavenumber.
operation: assemble the L/J-pole fluid dispersion matrix
species scales and L/J pole tables to a complex kx eigenmatrix
discovery.model: homogeneous magnetized multi-species Maxwellian fluid pole expansion
discovery.boundary: finite nonzero omega, nonzero gyrofrequencies, positive pole radii and matched coefficient axes; source resonance denominators must not vanish and the assembled matrix must remain finite

identity.relation: species scales and L/J pole tables to a complex kx eigenmatrix
identity.direction: species scales and L/J pole tables to a complex kx eigenmatrix
identity.definition: Assemble M for kx X=M X in [vx_snl,vy_snl,vz_snl,Ey,Ez,By,Bz] order; its dimension is 3*S*sum(L)+4.
identity.model: homogeneous magnetized multi-species Maxwellian fluid pole expansion
identity.coordinates: wavevector x-z plane; z parallel to B0; component and pole blocks retain source ordering
identity.boundary: finite nonzero omega, nonzero gyrofrequencies, positive pole radii and matched coefficient axes; source resonance denominators must not vanish and the assembled matrix must remain finite
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: omega
inputs.description: Fixed angular frequency entering the resonance denominators and the Maxwell curl term

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: Parallel wavenumber entering the parallel resonance and curl term

inputs.name: c2
inputs.description: Speed of light squared in vacuum

inputs.name: wcs
inputs.description: Signed cyclotron frequency of each species

inputs.name: cn_residues
inputs.description: L-pole residue table indexed by coefficient order 1..`max_harmonic+1`
inputs.shape: Mapping whose values are complex arrays
inputs.constraints: Covers every required order and is finite.

inputs.name: cn_poles
inputs.shape: Mapping whose values are complex arrays
inputs.constraints: Covers every required order and is finite.

inputs.name: order_lengths
inputs.description: Number of poles at each order

inputs.name: czj
inputs.description: Pole locations of the Z-pole approximation

outputs.name: M
outputs.units: Mixed dimensions (each block normalized to its own physical quantity)

outputs.name: n_sl
outputs.description: Velocity-expansion dimension of each species $\sum_l L(l)$

outputs.name: n_sl3
outputs.description: Total dimension of the three velocity-component blocks $3\,NSL$

outputs.name: matrix_size
outputs.constraints: Matches the number of rows of `M`.

outputs.name: n_l
outputs.description: Total number of poles per species over all harmonics

outputs.name: nonzero_entries
outputs.description: Number of nonzero matrix entries, for structural checks
outputs.constraints: At most the total number of matrix entries.

outputs.name: state_layout
outputs.constraints: Fixed to `vx_snl, vy_snl, vz_snl, Ey, Ez, By, Bz`.

preconditions: finite nonzero omega, nonzero gyrofrequencies, positive pole radii and matched coefficient axes
Source 1/xsj and 1/(xsj^2-m^2) resonance denominators must not vanish; M must remain finite.
supported: Assemble the dense first-order fluid eigenmatrix for fixed angular frequency and parallel wavenumber.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for declared invalid inputs and nonfinite assembled M, including singular source resonance denominators; numeric conversion errors may propagate for unsupported Python objects.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Numerical backend errors propagate; no fallback relation is substituted.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative root solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: assemble_fluid_dispersion_matrix(*, omega, kz, c2, epsilon0, wps2, wcs, vts, rhocs, sgns, absrhocs, cn_residues, cn_poles, order_lengths, bzj, czj, max_harmonic, n_species)

example.description: Build one zero-harmonic fluid matrix from the derived species scales and check its finite shape.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import derive_species_equilibrium_scales, get_gamma_lpole_coefficients, get_z_pole_coefficients
from scirel.kinetic import assemble_fluid_dispersion_matrix
s=derive_species_equilibrium_scales(ms=[9.1094e-31],qs=[-1.60217662e-19],ns_unit=[1],Ts_unit=[1],B0=1,n00=6.075e19,T00=1000); l=get_gamma_lpole_coefficients(max_harmonic=0); z=get_z_pole_coefficients(j_order=8); r=assemble_fluid_dispersion_matrix(omega=s['wn'],kz=0.1*s['kn'],c2=s['c2'],epsilon0=s['epsilon0'],wps2=s['wps2'],wcs=s['wcs'],vts=s['vts'],rhocs=s['rhocs'],sgns=s['sgns'],absrhocs=s['absrhocs'],cn_residues=l['residues'],cn_poles=l['poles'],order_lengths=l['order_lengths'],bzj=z['bzj'],czj=z['czj'],max_harmonic=0,n_species=1); assert r['M'].shape==(40,40)
example.expected: Observed PASS: the one-species, zero-harmonic witness returns a finite 40x40 complex matrix and its declared size/layout metadata.
